target: 100% completion of the selected original PlayStation 2 route, spoiler-free

areas.name: PS2 Route and Controls
areas.location_cue: The original PlayStation 2 title screen, input calibration, Room 104, and first save room.
areas.note: Establish the selected build and all supported control methods before the completion runs.

levels.1: This entry has one complete platform route.
levels.2: Play the original PlayStation 2 release on native hardware or a tested emulator.
levels.3: Use an unmodified disc image from your own copy, confirm the region and save-card identity, and test aiming, movies, audio, vibration, and memory-card writes before beginning. There is no secondary or remastered content route to merge.

levels.1: Exploration and aiming use different camera styles.
levels.2: Verify third-person movement and first-person aiming with a DualShock 2.
levels.3: In the opening safe space, test walking, running, turning, the quick turn, aiming, firing, reloading, the status screen, and direct map access. Confirm that releasing aim returns to third-person movement without losing input.

levels.1: The game supports its contemporary light-gun route.
levels.2: Connect and calibrate a compatible GunCon 2 before starting a separate control test.
levels.3: Use supported display hardware, calibrate at the game's prompt, confirm edge and center accuracy, then complete one encounter and one movement corridor. Record any display or region limitation; do not claim light-gun completion from an uncalibrated adapter.

levels.1: A second pointing method can replace stick aiming.
levels.2: Connect a compatible USB mouse and verify first-person cursor response.
levels.3: Boot with the mouse connected, test horizontal and vertical travel, both fire and action inputs, sensitivity, and return to movement. Complete one encounter without controller aiming, then retain the configuration record with the save.

items.label: Use a Typewriter and Ammo Cabinet

levels.1: Safe rooms support both saving and basic ammunition recovery.
levels.2: Enter the second-deck Lounge and test the typewriter and handgun-ammunition cabinet.
levels.3: Make a numbered memory-card save without an ink ribbon, withdraw handgun ammunition, leave the room, and return to confirm the cabinet refresh. Do not repeatedly refill during a rank attempt if the extra movement threatens its time target.

levels.1: Door colors show which routes still need an item.
levels.2: Open the map directly and compare passable, locked, and opened doors.
levels.3: Stand beside one locked door, note its map mark, unlock it with the correct item, then reopen the map and verify the changed connection. Use this visual check before abandoning any deck.

save_backup.title: Clone the memory card before testing
save_backup.why: Control and result experiments should never overwrite the master file.

areas.name: Passenger and Leisure Deck Route
areas.location_cue: Guest cabins, VIP room, spiral staircase, restaurant, pool, third-class rooms, bar, and store space.
areas.note: Collect route items before each deck becomes inconvenient or inaccessible.

levels.1: The earliest required key shares a room with a map.
levels.2: Search the rear corridor of Room 101 for the 1st Class Key and Upper Decks Map.
levels.3: Enter Room 101 from Guest Room 1, cross the living area, and inspect the body in the rear corridor. Take both objects, return promptly, and use the key on the double doors at the end of Guest Room 1.

levels.1: The VIP space contains both a document and electronic access.
levels.2: Take the Guest Keycard beside the seated body in the VIP Room.
levels.3: Collect the nearby file first, then take the card and leave before the room becomes crowded. At the Spiral Staircase Hall panel, insert the card to enable the corresponding second-deck electronic doors.

levels.1: A bed in the second-class rooms holds the next access credential.
levels.2: Take the ID Card from Room 203 and return to the Spiral Staircase Hall panel.
levels.3: Enter Room 203 through its open doorway, collect the card from the bed, and withdraw immediately. Use it at the first-floor panel to enable the restaurant-pool side and the third-class side.

levels.1: The pool machinery provides a key before the hatch itself can open.
levels.2: Take the Maintenance Key from the Pool Deck control panel.
levels.3: Approach the control panel near the closed deck hatch, collect the key, and read the paper fixed beside the hatch. Carry the key through the third-class corridor and use it on the shutter leading toward the Stairs Hall.

levels.1: A removable control part was stored away from the pool.
levels.2: Take the Handle from the Store House shelf and return to the Pool Deck.
levels.3: Search the Store House shelving after entering from the bar-side route. Collect the diary and supplies before taking the Handle, then return to the pool machinery and fit it into the hatch control to open the downward route.

levels.1: A tool on the lower ship deck opens marked cargo containers.
levels.2: Collect the Crowbar from the Presentation Room floor.
levels.3: Read the report on the northern display stand, then take the Crowbar lying nearby. Leave through the available route and carry it into the Cargo Room; do not discard it before the required crate search.

levels.1: The required cargo container changes between runs.
levels.2: Use the Crowbar on marked crew crates until the Crewman's Keycard appears.
levels.3: Make a save before entering the Cargo Room, open marked crates systematically along one wall, and continue until the keycard is found. The correct crate is randomized, so a fixed box number is unreliable; optional medicine can occupy other crates.

levels.1: The lower-deck monitor room holds an emblem-shaped key.
levels.2: Take the Recreation Room Key from the Monitor Room and use it in Bar Seven Seas.
levels.3: Collect the key and Restructuring Notice from the Monitor Room, return through the lower-deck route, then unlock the symbol-marked door on the east side of Bar Seven Seas to reach the stairs and captain's section.

levels.1: A later ship segment begins a difficulty-dependent timer.
levels.2: Reach the heliport within seven minutes on So Sweet, five on Recommend, or 135 seconds on Extreme.
levels.3: Back up before the timer begins, reload all carried weapons, and memorize the direct door sequence. Ignore optional fights, take only supplies already on the path, and reach the heliport before the displayed clock expires; Extreme permits two minutes fifteen seconds.

save_backup.title: Back up before the timed escape
save_backup.why: The difficulty timer and one-way transitions make cleanup unreliable.

point_of_no_return.title: Timed heliport approach
point_of_no_return.warning: Finish every upper- and lower-deck collection before completing the escape.

areas.name: Wastewater, Freight, and Laboratory Route
areas.location_cue: Concrete channels, lettered freight corridors, storage aisles, residence rooms, and clean-room approach.
areas.note: Complete each map and file sweep before using its lift or final access item.

levels.1: The first wastewater passage contains a map and heavy weapon.
levels.2: Collect the Groundwater Ways B1 Map and Grenade Launcher in Sewer Passage A.
levels.3: After reaching the wastewater area, check Sewer Passage A before advancing. Take the wall map and launcher, load it only when needed, and preserve grenade rounds for threats that cannot be safely bypassed.

levels.1: A body in the channels carries the administrative key.
levels.2: Take the Sector Admin Key from the body in Waterway D.
levels.3: Traverse the B2 channels after obtaining their map, inspect the body in Waterway D, and take the key. Return to the matching control-room door and unlock it before moving deeper into the freight section.

levels.1: The deepest freight lift needs its own card.
levels.2: Take the Elevator Keycard from the body in Freight Passageway G.
levels.3: Search the body beyond the freight gate in Passageway G, collect the nearby paper and ammunition, then carry the card to the B5 Elevator Room. Insert it at the lift control only after finishing the freight map and file sweep.

levels.1: Noise matters more than firepower in one freight encounter.
levels.2: Move quietly through the dark room and attack only during a safe opening.
levels.3: Make a save beforehand, walk instead of running, avoid unnecessary gunfire, and use directional sound to keep distance from the large occupant. If combat becomes mandatory, create space, strike its exposed target, and resume quiet movement toward the exit.

levels.1: The laboratory storage aisles contain a red access card.
levels.2: Take the Pod Bay Keycard from the last aisle of the first-floor storage room.
levels.3: Sweep the storage room from its entrance: collect the memo and map in the first aisle, then continue to the last aisle for the card. Ride the elevator to the third floor and use it on the Pod Landing Place door.

levels.1: A blank recorder must be filled at a separate terminal.
levels.2: Take the Digital Recorder from the Pod Landing Place, then open the email in Room 2D-01.
levels.3: Collect the recorder from the northwest computer desk on 3F, descend to 2F, and examine the corner computer in Room 2D-01. Open the email and accept the recording prompt to convert it into the full recorder.

levels.1: The filled recorder supplies the required audio sample.
levels.2: Use the full Digital Recorder on the first-floor voice panel.
levels.3: Return to the first-floor corridor, examine the panel beside the locked clean-room door, and play the recorded message. Confirm that the door opens and that the recorder has served its purpose before entering.

levels.1: The laboratory's open chamber contains the final weapon and an exit key.
levels.2: Take the rifle, its manual, and the Backyard Key from the open laboratory chamber.
levels.3: Read the manual beside the weapon, collect the Charged Particle Rifle, and inspect the body inside the opened chamber for the Backyard Key. Fully charge each shot; the weapon uses a limited energy supply rather than ordinary ammunition.

levels.1: The last corridors close the remaining exploration window.
levels.2: Finish all files, maps, weapons, and key-item records before leaving the final save room.
levels.3: Compare the archive against all nineteen files, six maps, and eight weapons; reload and fill every carried weapon, take recovery supplies, and create a separate memory-card backup. Keep this save for rank practice and alternate-character verification.

save_backup.title: Keep the final save-room backup
save_backup.why: It preserves rank practice and collection verification.

point_of_no_return.title: Leave the final save room
point_of_no_return.warning: The remaining approach does not support a full area cleanup.

areas.name: Result Formula and Rank Tiers
areas.location_cue: The post-clear result screen showing combat, accuracy, time, saves, recovery use, bonuses, and total grade.
areas.note: Calculate ranks from verified factors rather than relying on vague speed advice.

levels.1: The result screen rewards one part of the enemy-clear percentage.
levels.2: Divide the percentage of the full enemy population defeated by four.
levels.3: At the result screen, record the defeated-enemy percentage and divide it by four for this component. Avoid guessing the assumed population from a partial route; use the displayed percentage as the authoritative input.

levels.1: Accurate weak-point shots add a separate score component.
levels.2: Divide the critical-hit percentage among defeated enemies by three.
levels.3: Record both defeated targets and confirmed critical defeats, then use the result-screen percentage divided by three. A missed shot does not directly reduce this component unless it changes the displayed ratio.

levels.1: Faster completion provides up to thirty points.
levels.3: Compare the final clear time against the first strict boundary it satisfies: under 120 minutes gives 30; then under 135 gives 25, under 150 gives 20, under 180 gives 15, under 240 gives 10, and under 300 gives 5.

levels.1: Fewer typewriter uses preserve up to fifteen points.
levels.2: Earn 15 points with zero saves, 10 below four, or 5 below eight.
levels.3: For a maximum attempt, make no in-game save and rely on a separate cloned starting file for practice. Otherwise finish with one to three saves for 10 points, or four to seven for 5; eight or more earns none here.

levels.1: Full-recovery sprays reduce one scoring category.
levels.2: Earn 15 points with none, 10 below two, or 5 below four sprays.
levels.3: Use herbs or Herbal Medicine when recovery is necessary. Zero Medicinal Sprays gives 15 points; exactly one gives 10; two or three give 5; four or more provide no points in this factor.

levels.1: A low-combat, no-assistance route grants the largest bonus.
levels.2: Finish below 30 defeated enemies with zero saves and zero Medicinal Sprays.
levels.3: Plan a bypass route, defeat only mandatory targets, and confirm the final defeated count remains under 30. Do not save or use Medicinal Spray at any point; meeting all three conditions adds 50 points.

levels.1: A combat-heavy precision route earns a different bonus.
levels.2: Defeat more than 100 enemies while keeping critical hits above 75 percent.
levels.3: Use silenced or standard handguns for controlled weak-point shots, avoid wasteful body finishes, and verify both final values: defeated count must exceed 100 and the critical-hit percentage must exceed 75. The bonus adds 40 points.

levels.1: The fastest route must also avoid saving.
levels.2: Clear in under 60 minutes without using a typewriter.
levels.3: Practice each transition on cloned saves, then begin a continuous run. Skip nonessential pickups and fights, never create an in-game save, and finish before 60:00 to add 30 points.

levels.1: The highest result tier starts above a fixed point boundary.
levels.2: Finish with more than 90 total result points.
levels.3: Add enemy-clear, critical-hit, time, save, and spray points plus any earned conditional bonus. The total must exceed 90; a displayed total of exactly 90 does not satisfy the documented wording.

levels.1: The second tier supports several reward routes.
levels.2: Finish above 65 points without reaching S.
levels.3: Calculate every category and bonus, then finish above 65 while below the S boundary. Preserve the result save because A on different difficulties unlocks distinct starting equipment.

levels.1: A middle result still produces a recorded completion tier.
levels.2: Finish above 40 points without reaching A.
levels.3: Use a cloned run and intentionally relax one score category after securing the campaign clear. Confirm the total remains above 40 but does not cross the A boundary, then retain the result screen.

levels.1: The lowest result tier completes the rank archive.
levels.2: Finish at 40 points or below.
levels.3: On a separate archival file, use enough saves, time, or sprays to hold the final total at 40 or less while still completing the campaign. Never damage the higher-rank reward file for this demonstration.

save_backup.title: Clone a completed route for rank tests
save_backup.why: Deliberately lowering a score should not replace a reward save.

areas.name: Difficulty Clears and Completion Rewards
areas.location_cue: New Game difficulty selection, result-file replay prompt, alternate title presentation, and opening inventories.
areas.note: Complete all difficulty, replay, rank, control, and reward states.

levels.1: The forgiving mode changes supplies and starting equipment.
levels.2: Finish the full campaign on So Sweet and preserve its result save.
levels.3: Collect its difficulty-specific weapon placements, complete the file and map ledger, meet the seven-minute deck escape, and finish once for a clean result. Keep this file for its separate rank-reward tiers.

levels.1: The middle mode uses the standard resource layout.
levels.2: Finish the full campaign on Recommend and preserve its result save.
levels.3: Start from a clean Recommend file, collect the Shotgun in the Freezing Room and Assault Rifle in the suit room, meet the five-minute deck escape, and finish with all nineteen files before saving the result.

levels.1: The hardest route reduces supplies and tightens the escape timer.
levels.2: Finish the full campaign on Extreme and preserve its result save.
levels.3: Practice on cloned saves, avoid optional combat, collect only route-critical resources and archives, meet the 135-second deck escape, and reach the final encounter with reserved Magnum and heavy ammunition.

levels.1: A cleared result file changes the next campaign start.
levels.2: Complete any difficulty, reload its result data, and accept the alternate-character prompt.
levels.3: Save after the first clear, choose New Game from that same result file, and answer yes when the alternate-character option appears. Verify the campaign starts under the alternate model and retain a separate save before overwriting anything.

levels.1: The replay option should be carried through the entire route.
levels.2: Finish one full campaign after selecting the alternate playable character.
levels.3: Use the cleared result file, select the alternate-character option, verify the changed starting inventory, then complete every physical section and save the result. The route structure is shared, so do not expose character or plot identities in public hints.

items.label: Unlock and Test the Title Colors

levels.1: The first clear adds a cosmetic title-screen option.
levels.2: Finish once, return to the title screen, and cycle its available color presentation.
levels.3: After saving a completed result, return to the title screen and use the newly enabled color-changing input or option. Capture every distinct color state and confirm it remains available after a cold boot.

levels.1: A strong So Sweet result expands the next starting inventory.
levels.2: Earn at least A on So Sweet to begin with all handguns and the Shotgun.
levels.3: Finish So Sweet above 65 points, save the result, and start a new game from it. Verify the standard, silenced, and semi-automatic handguns plus Shotgun are available at the opening inventory.

levels.1: The top So Sweet result adds nearly the complete conventional arsenal.
levels.2: Earn S on So Sweet to start with every weapon except the Charged Particle Rifle.
levels.3: Finish So Sweet above 90 points, save the result, and load a new game from it. Verify all seven conventional firearms are present and the energy rifle is absent; record ammunition quantities separately.

levels.1: A strong middle-mode result matches the broad So Sweet reward.
levels.2: Earn at least A on Recommend to start with every weapon except the Charged Particle Rifle.
levels.3: Finish Recommend above 65 points, preserve the result file, then start a new campaign from it. Confirm all conventional firearms appear and the laboratory energy rifle remains excluded.

levels.1: The highest middle-mode result adds unlimited conventional ammunition.
